chapter.verse: Bang thu hangin minamte in siat nading ah kithukhat sim a, mite in a mawk nading sawmsim uh hiam?
Leitung kumpite leh gam ukte in, Topa leh ama sathau nilhpa langpangin vaihawm uh a,
“Amau’ hong hennate su-tat khia-in, amau khaute ei kiang panin paikhia ni,” ci uh hi.
Vantunga tu-pa in nuihsan a, tua Topa in amaute zahko hi.
Tua ciangin hehna tawh amau kiangah thu gen ding a, heh luatna tawh amaute linglawng sakin,
“Ka mual siangtho Zion tungah ka Kumpi ka tusak khin hi,” ci hi.
Topa’ thukhenna kong gen ding hi; Amah in kei’ tungah, “Nang in ka tapa na hi a, tuni in nang kong piang sak khin zo hi.
Keima tungah hong ngen in; nangma luah dingin minamte ka bawl ding a, leimong dongin nangma neihsa ka hisak ding hi.
Siktawn khat tawh amaute na satkham ding a, beelseekpa’ beel den’khap bangin amaute lei-ah na dengzan ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpite aw, tu-in pil un; leitung gam ukte aw, thu phawk un.

Launa tawh Topa ’ na sem un la, liin’na tawh lungdamin, a khe nam un; tua hi kei leh amah sinso-in, lam kal-ah na sia-mang ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama hehna kitawhkuang pak hi. Amah a bel khempeuh mi nuamsate ahi hi.
